key_line.detail: NCO $3.4M, 0.18% annualised; provision $5.1M vs $13.3M in Q2; NPLs $71.7M = 0.95% of loans vs 0.91%; allowance 0.85%. Recoveries only $112k this quarter, so the guided $7.5-10M recoveries from the hunt have not shown up yet. No repeat of July's credit hit.

guidance.detail: Release gives no numeric guidance; dividend $0.40 declared 2026-10-19 described as an increase. Any guide is on the 9:00 ET call.

call.detail: Call started 09:00 ET today and runs into the first minutes of the session; outcome not known at the time of writing. NIM outlook and the recovery timing are the lines that could move it.

public_reaction.summary: Only a snippet-level summary of the release (itiger) found; no analyst actions or price-target changes dated this morning surfaced in search.

tape_read.note: Robust reference 91.99 (+3.5%) vs release read +4.0%; after-hours last 93.20 (+4.9%), pre-market high 92.71, low 89.00. Stale: 11 prints, none in the last 30 minutes, last at 07:07, so the open is uncertain. Market flat-to-up (IWM +0.36%).

thesis_check.note: Long thesis was guide arithmetic at $2.50-2.60 over a $2.38-2.48 bar with credit as the risk; EPS $2.58 lands at the top and credit was benign. The promised recoveries did not appear in Q3.

expected.open_lag_note: Pre-market is stale (last print 07:07) but after-hours sat higher at +4.9% and the beat is clean, so the open likely holds most of the +3.5%; amc gaps of this size tend to give some back in the first half hour, with the call running into the open as a two-way risk.

recommendation.reason: De cijfers bevestigen de long-these (winst per aandeel $2,58 boven de lat, rentemarge omhoog, kredietverliezen laag) en de voorbeurs staat al ongeveer waar de cijfers het rechtvaardigen (+3,5%). Bij avondcijfers geeft de koers na de opening vaak iets terug en de analistencall loopt nog tijdens de opening, dus de winst meenemen bij de opening, zoals de standaardregel.
recommendation.what_would_change_it: Als de call vóór 09:30 een duidelijke opwaartse NIM- of winstverwachting of de beloofde terugvorderingen bevestigt en de voorbeurs richting $93 of hoger loopt, dan is vasthouden tot de slotkoers te overwegen.
